name: worktree-write-scope-owners
body: Worktree-write-scope coverage sits on narrow owners: `solution.component.worktree-isolation-guide` (implemented-by the file-tool guidance in `AGENTS.md`), `solution.component.worktree-boundary-tests` (implemented-by `opencode-suite/tests/boundary.e2e.test.ts`), and the bodies of `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt`, `solution.component.agent-fs-permission-grants`, `solution.component.agent-fs-tool-suite` (implemented-by `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.fsScopeDecision`), and `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`. `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` carries the file-tool guidance and `solution.component.agent-roster-docs` carries AGENTS.md + README.md.
